senses.gloss:
m. (-क्कः)
A young elephant.
E.
दिक् an imitative sound, and क who utters, some books have धिक्क, and others विक्क in place of this word.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Young, juvenile.
f. (-री)
A young woman.
E.
दिक् inflection of दिश place, कर who makes; who is restlessly active, changing place continually.

m. (-तिः)
A regent of a quarter of the universe, as the Sun of the east; Saturn of the west; Mars of the south; Mercury of the north; Venus of the south-east; Rāhu of the south-west; Candra of the north-west; and Jupiter of the north-east.
E.
दिश्, and पति master: see the next.

m. (-लः)
A regent of a quarter of the universe, as INDRA of the east; AGNI of the south-east; YAMA of the south; NAIRṚTA of the south-west; VARUṆA of the west; MARUT of the north-west; KUVERA of the north; ĪŚĀNA of the south-east.
E.
दिश्, and पाल who protects: this word is applicable to the Dikpatis, (see the last,) as that term is to these also.

n. (-लं)
An inauspicious planetary conjunction, as for the Sun and Venus to be in the west, &c.
E.
दिश्, and शूल a spear or stake.

r. 1st cl. (दीक्षति)
1 To be shaved.
2 To perform a sacrifice.
3 To initiate.
4 To teach religious observances.
4 To be self-restrained.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Sacrificing, offering oblations.
2 Worshipping in general.
3 Engaging in a course of austerities.
4 Certain ceremonies preliminary to a sacrifice.
5 Receiving the initiatory Mantra or incantation.
E.
दा to give, (knowledge,) and क्षि to destroy, (sin); deriv. irr. or दीक्ष to initiate, &c. affix अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-ष्टि)
A particular sacrifice, that preceded by the Dīkṣa: see the next.
E.
दीक्षा as below, छ affix, and इष्टि a sacrifice.

m. (-न्तः)
A supplementary sacrifice, one made to atone for any defects in a preceding one.
E.
दिक्षा sacrifice, and अन्त completion, end.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Initiated.
2 Performed, (as the Dīkṣa ceremony.)
3 One by whom the preparatory ceremonies have been observed.
m. (-तः)
1 An assemblage of priests for peculiar ceremonies, or for any sacrifice.
2 The pupil of an ascetick.
E.
दीक्ष to perform a sacrifice or to be initiated, affix क्त.

m. (-ता)
A spiritual father, the communicator of the initiatory Mantra or prayer.
E.
दीक्ष to sacrifice, &c. तृच् aff.
